events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: A Confirmation

options.text: I hereby declare that [character] is my one true heir!
Don't push me - I have not made up my mind yet.

events.text: [character] approaches the throne with a demand. "The rumors that swirl about your many other... relationships have reached me, and I am worried for the future of our son. You must confirm him as the heir, right away."

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: A House of Song

options.text: My palace is at least equal.
I dare not compare my palace to that of Ahura Mazda.
The house may not compare, but is certainly filled with song!

events.text: The court stand enchanted as a young poet sings of the House of Song, the dwelling of Ahura Mazda where the righteous souls travel after death. “But we’re already in the most beautiful house of song!” [character] shouts out after the performance. Many smile at the compliment to you, but the glowering face of [character] warns you of trouble. Sure enough, he is quickly on his feet demanding that [character] take back what is surely an insult to Ahura Mazda. Every head turns expectantly to see how you respond.

events.author: Brodie Frehlich
events.name: A Voice Breaks Through

options.text: This could work. Thank the [tribe] for their aid.
The risk is too high. We will defeat [rival] by more conventional means.

outcomes.label: A Voice Breaks Through Option Peace
A Voice Breaks Through Option Alliance

events.text: Tensions mount as your court gathers to discuss the ongoing war with [rival]. As chairs scrape and voices rise, a cry from your Ambassador, [character], breaks through the cacophony of noise. “Listen, please!” He waits for the others to quiet before continuing. “While it is no secret that the [rival] army is stronger than our own, the [tribe] share this common enemy. Their scouts claim to know the location of General [character], leader of [rival], and have shared this information with us in good faith. If we seek out and strike down [character] in the field of battle, we might at the very least weaken their forces and hurt their morale.” Murmurs break the short-lived silence as your courtiers exchange glances and look to you.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: A Warning of Judgment

options.text: Thank him for the warning, this has been a wake up call.
Maybe, I will find that out in time.
Throw him out.

events.text: [character] seeks an urgent audience with you, claiming to carry a warning. He greets you with a somber tone before reminding you of your dedication to Ahura Mazda and of the reckoning that all must face after their deaths in this world; every deed weighed on how much good it contributed to Ahura Mazda. When you face yourself at the final judgment, will the Bridge of the Separator stay wide for you to cross to the House of Song? Or will it continue to narrow until you cannot help but fall to the House of Lies? [character] is worried that as things currently are, you might not make it across.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Adopted Successor

options.text: Agree, there can be no doubts on the royal line.
Regardless of blood, [character] is your family and will inherit as such.

events.text: [character], [relative], confronts you about the line of succession, arguing that [character] should be excluded due to him being adopted. Adoption is not an uncommon practice in [rival], although clarity in ancestry is vital when it comes to succession. Is [character] pressing this for his own gain or genuinely concerned for the [rival] line?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: After the Yasna

options.text: We should dine like this all the time!
Discuss the intricacies of the yasna ritual.
Perhaps we should spend more time together…

events.text: The morning yasna ritual is a dedication to Ahura Mazda, recreating his creation of the world. After the meat is dedicated to the fire, the gods are pleased with the scent and intention of the offering; meaning that the meat can be shared between the celebrating Magi and worshipers to eat. You have increasingly enjoyed your long conversations with [character] over the food, discussing everything from tactics to the latest gossip.

events.author: Zorbaz
events.name: Age of Empires

tip: As leader: +5% Unit Trait Modifier / Infantry
As general: +10% Unit Trait Modifier / Infantry

options.text: I want to see my enemies grovel before me!
We can never have too many soldiers and ships.
Send your generals to gather resources rather than fight.

events.text: Your armies await your command! Our thousands of stalwart warriors train ceaselessly across the vast lands of our domain and stand ready at all times to bring war to your adversaries. The rasp of steel on whetstones can be heard in every barracks and battlefield as our armies tread across the fields of glory. How shall we use this unprecedented swell of military support?

events.author: Zorbaz
events.name: Age of Heroes

tip: As leader: +5% Unit Trait Modifier / Infantry
As general: +10% Unit Trait Modifier / Infantry

options.text: Yes, the let ages ring with our legend.
I will not be remembered as the cause for so many deaths.

events.text: As you ride at the head of the triumphal march in [city], your battle-hardened soldiers march to the cheers of the jubilant throng. [character] and [character] ride beside you, their martial countenance the envy of kings and the backbone of your army's morale. Let us seize this moment, my [title]! This is truly an Age of Heroes! Let history echo with the tales of our valor!

events.author: Zorbaz
events.name: Age of Literacy

options.text: We must educate those who still cannot read.
Let us make use of these literate masses and advance our learning.
We shall prepare an army of clerks and scribes for military matters.

events.text: There has never been a time in the history of [rival] where the literacy of the entire population of the land has been this widespread. Commoners across the land carry on their business in letters and numbers, reading public decrees and writing letters to loved ones. Agreements between parties are written, and more often than not both sides can read the details for themselves. Surely this is a time of great economic growth and civil unity! How shall we harness these advances?

events.author: Zorbaz
events.name: Age of Piety

options.text: We must provide lodging and safe passage for those blessed souls.
We shall build a great gate for them as they enter [city].
They shall have to fend for themselves.

events.text: There has never been a time in the history of [rival] where the land has been overflowing with such faith and piety. Countless souls have been saved from the horrors and abominations of a life of darkness and sin. At least once in their lives, uncounted hundreds of thousands will travel to [city] from nations across the known world for a pilgrimage and visit our most upright nation. How shall we thank God for his blessings and ensure these blessings for future generations?

events.author: Zorbaz
events.name: Age of Tolerance

options.text: True faith expresses itself in our actions and our words.
We must meet with the religious leaders of our cities, to find common ground.
Ensure this stability by force. Any religious fanatics shall be imprisoned.

events.text: An age of tolerance and good will fills the land. Practitioners of all religions live in relative harmony and peace. Theological arguments are filled with heated words and vigorous gestures rather than drawn blade and spilled blood. There has never been a time such as this in the annals of our nation. How shall we strengthen these bonds and ensure tranquillity among the faiths?

events.author: Zorbaz
events.name: Age of Wonders

options.text: We shall procure much needed building materials.
We should celebrate our magnificence in sculpture!
Let us tax all of the visiting dignitaries.

events.text: There has never been, nor will there ever be, a city as great as [city] or [city]! The crown jewels of our empire are filled with wonders beyond count. Tribesmen in distant deserts and frozen lands whisper in awe of our magnificence. Magnates and ambassadors from across the known world marvel at <p.is_sub.S1=SUBJECT_CITY_PYRAMIDS>Pyramids<p=SUBJECT_CITY_GREAT_ZIGGURAT>Great Ziggurat<p=SUBJECT_CITY_ORACLE>Oracle<p=SUBJECT_CITY_HANGING_GARDENS>Hanging Gardens<p=SUBJECT_CITY_NECROPOLIS>Necropolis<p=SUBJECT_CITY_ISHTAR_GATE>Ishtar Gate<p=SUBJECT_CITY_LIGHTHOUSE>Lighthouse<p=SUBJECT_CITY_APADANA>Apadana<p=SUBJECT_CITY_MAUSOLEUM>Mausoleum<p=SUBJECT_CITY_ACROPOLIS>Acropolis<p=SUBJECT_CITY_COLOSSUS>Colossus<p=SUBJECT_CITY_MUSAEUM>Musaeum<p=SUBJECT_CITY_CIRCUS_MAXIMUS>Circus Maximus<p=SUBJECT_CITY_PANTHEON>Pantheon<p=SUBJECT_CITY_HAGIA_SOPHIA>Hagia Sophia<p=SUBJECT_CITY_VIA_RECTA_SOUK>Via Recta Souk<else>the wonders<end> of [city] and <p.is_sub.S2=SUBJECT_CITY_VIA_RECTA_SOUK>Via Recta Souk<p=SUBJECT_CITY_HAGIA_SOPHIA>Hagia Sophia<p=SUBJECT_CITY_PANTHEON>Pantheon<p=SUBJECT_CITY_CIRCUS_MAXIMUS>Circus Maximus<p=SUBJECT_CITY_MUSAEUM>Musaeum<p=SUBJECT_CITY_COLOSSUS>Colossus<p=SUBJECT_CITY_ACROPOLIS>Acropolis<p=SUBJECT_CITY_MAUSOLEUM>Mausoleum<p=SUBJECT_CITY_APADANA>Apadana<p=SUBJECT_CITY_LIGHTHOUSE>Lighthouse<p=SUBJECT_CITY_ISHTAR_GATE>Ishtar Gate<p=SUBJECT_CITY_NECROPOLIS>Necropolis<p=SUBJECT_CITY_HANGING_GARDENS>Hanging Gardens<p=SUBJECT_CITY_ORACLE>Oracle<p=SUBJECT_CITY_GREAT_ZIGGURAT>Great Ziggurat<p=SUBJECT_CITY_PYRAMIDS>Pyramids<else>the wonders<end> of [city], and the proud people of these cities. How shall we embellish [rival]'s glorious reputation as the empire of wonders?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Agent Exposed

options.text: Return to us, before anything worse happens.
Your work is too important to stop now.

events.text: Your agent [character] has been living as one of the [rival] of [city], eating, sleeping, and working with them. While at the market, he hears rumors of a new technology that is spreading across [rival], and he is making moves to try and acquire it for ourselves. Such direct questions have aroused suspicion, and [character] is sure that he is being tailed by guards. However, there is an informant who may be able to deliver the needed scrolls. Should [character] be risked to get our hands on this new technology?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Agent Wounded

options.text: Return to us for treatment.
Your work is too important to stop now.

events.text: Urgent word has arrived from the network of agents in [city]: [character] has been wounded while trying to retrieve secrets from [rival] informant. The meeting was a trap, guards surrounding the building and forcing [character] to cut a path through. Luckily, the informant was killed, and [character] kept his face covered, so his role there is not compromised. However, the wound could get worse if it is not seen to soon.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Ahuna Vairya

options.text: I must meditate on this further.
I have better things to do.

events.text: ‘As a lord rules with power, so the spiritual rule according to asha. The benefits of good thought are reaped by those who act with good purpose. Ahura Mazda is with the lord, established as pastor for the humble and devout.’ The [religion] prayer of the Ahuna Vairya echoes around in your mind.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: All Is Vanity

options.text: Challenge him yourself.
Allow him to continue.
Ban him from debating in [city].

events.text: There is a philosophical crisis happening in the streets of [city]; a well known orator is practising his skills of rhetoric by arguing circles around any challengers. His arguments center around his interpretation of the [religion] teachings of the Scrolls of Ecclesiastes, that life is temporary as a single breath and people are so focused on themselves that they miss it. Your servants bring a report that although the teachings are entertaining to watch, his pessimistic view of life is affecting the whole city. He encourages keeping to [religion] law and is not technically breaking any rules. How do you want to handle this situation?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Always Vigilant

options.text: Maybe we can find a price that will soothe this over.
Surely we can talk about this?
I am done worrying about a dagger in the night.
Not yet, we will wait to strike when the time is right...

events.text: It is rather tiring, always remaining alert, always ready for danger. However, it has saved your life more than a couple of times. When another of [character] plots are foiled, this one a daggered assassin that you manage to spot in the crowd, it feels like a more permanent solution is needed. Sooner or later a vial of poison or a hidden blade will escape your notice...

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Apostate King

options.text: Adopt the ways of [religion].
Make [religion] the new State Religion of [rival].
It doesn’t matter what I believe.

events.text: [character] confronts you about following a religion other than the State Religion. He claims that your practice of [religion] while [religion] is the State Religion of [rival] is creating tension and unrest amongst your people. [character] wants an answer. Will you convert to [religion] or keep your [religion] ways?

events.author: Zorbaz
events.name: Assassination Investigation

options.text: Yes, deal with the matter, and never speak of it again.
Let the investigation run its course. I am untouchable.
Still your blade and let me speak with him first.

events.text: [character] comes to you late one evening with concern written all over his face. "My [title], I have heard whispers among my little birds that [character] questions the circumstances of [character]'s death. He has begun an investigation. I believe this is a most concerning matter, but I have a rather... sharp solution in mind. Do I have your approval?"

events.author: Zorbaz
events.name: Assassination Investigation

options.text: Yes, deal with the matter, and never speak of it again.
Let the investigation run its course. I am untouchable.
Still your blade and let me speak with him first.

events.text: [character] comes to you late one evening with concern written all over his face. "My [title], I have heard whispers among my little birds that [character] questions the circumstances of [character]'s death. He has begun an investigation. I believe this is a most concerning matter, but I have a rather... sharp solution in mind. Do I have your approval?"

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: Assassination Rumors

options.text: Remove [character] as a precaution.
[character] will pay for this betrayal.
My heir [character] has disappointed me.

events.text: Your spymaster [character] approaches after hearing whispers of conspiracy... of a plot by your husband and heir to have you assassinated. How shall we deal with these co-conspirators?

events.author: Gabe Campbell
events.name: Assimilation Problems

options.text: Our people are right to be exhausted with these haughty locals, [city] is our city now!
Let us pay off our new colonists in [city] and hope that this whole thing blows over.
We will do nothing.

events.text: Our new colonists in [city] are upset at the haughty and superior attitude of the original [rival] citizens. Although they are now our subjects, these [rival] openly flaunt their cultural achievements and make thinly veiled comments about restoring [rival] rule one day. Our own citizens, newly transplanted to [city], cannot stand this state of affairs and demand that you do something about the outrageous behavior. If you refuse, the rising Discontent in the city may get out of control. The threat of rebellion is never far off! We could mollify the anger of our own [rival] citizens with gifts of gold, or exile the [rival] and be rid of this issue altogether. How will you resolve these troubles?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Baby in a Basket

options.text: Allow [character] to keep the child.
Adopt the child as your own.
Demand that the baby is cast out.

events.text: <sentencecase>[relative]</sentencecase> [character] was down by the river when she heard a cry from the reeds. A basket had washed up onto the bank, with a baby bundled up inside. No one seems to know where the child came from or why they were there. [character] has brought the baby to you and is begging to be allowed to raise it as her own. The story mirrors that of the [religion] prophet Moses. Perhaps it is a sign?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Beating Poets

options.text: [character] is clearly the superior.
No one can best [character].
Let me show you how it is done.

events.text: The competition between [character] and [character] has been growing increasingly intense over the previous weeks. Each claims that their verses of praise to Ahura Mazda are the best and that the other is a follower of The Lie trying to lure the people away from the path of [religion]. Your advisors present the verses and implore you to step in before it comes to blows on the streets.

events.author: Velociryx
events.name: Bitter Harvest

options.text: Let's get drunk and plot against those who have wronged us.
Leverage [character]'s goodwill, getting his assistance in Court.

tip: As leader: +50 Unit Trait XP / Infantry
As governor: +100 Unit Trait XP / Infantry

options.text: Head to the training grounds with [character] to work off some of your shared frustration training your troops.

events.text: You've gained a new respect for [character]. Of late, you have been comparing notes about how unfairly both of you have been treated in this life, and your shared bitterness has blossomed into a somewhat begrudging friendship. Even though, deep down you actually kind of hate him, at least you understand him, and that's worth something. He's coming to Court next week for a scheduled visit. How shall the two of you spend your time?

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Bloodless Rebellion

options.text: Cede power to [character].
Ignore [character]'s request.
Ignore [character]... but make him suffer.
Surely you dare not ignore the many omens that the heavens themselves favor my rule?

events.text: After years of tolerating your rule, [character] believes that you have outlived your effectiveness. He speaks up in court, demanding that you step aside for the good of the nation. In his words, "You are weak, senile, and disliked by the populace." The choice is yours. Follow the suggestion of your rival and pass the throne to [character], or cling to your power and pride.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Bloodsport

options.text: We will not debase ourselves in this way.
Bring on the fighters! Bring on the blood!
Let us use the games to test our soldiers.
No, we will use these festivities for drama, poetry, and music.
I will fight as a gladiator myself!

events.text: Chancellor [character] attends a festive tribal gathering outside [city] and is treated to savage games of bloodsport and combat. He is surprised at the joyous crowds and how such base contests can ignite the blood of the common people. When the time comes for another tribal celebration, [character] encourages the court to offer our Circus Maximus as a venue. We could even train our own gladiatorial fighters.

events.author: Zorbaz
events.name: Chariot of the Anointed

options.text: Ready our chariots. We speak with [character] upon the road.
Close the palace gates. Do not let that madman in!

events.text: The watchmen of [city] have spotted a lone chariot racing towards the walls. Twice we sent messengers, but both times they fell behind, as the chariot charges recklessly along the roads. Our scouts believe that the charioteer is [character] from the daredevil racing style. [character] has recently been anointed by [character] and sworn to dethrone you. Perhaps he might be persuaded if you and your heir mounted your chariot and spoke with him on the roads. However, there is a certain amount of danger involved.

events.author: Velociryx
events.name: Child Labor Abuses

options.text: [character] is right and we should have ended the practice before now.
We will not have national policy dictated to us by the [tribe], but let us review our sentencing guildelines and release some [tribe] childen as a gesture of good faith.
Damn the [tribe] for their insolence! Work their children to death and marshal the army!

events.text: Your policy of allowing child labor in [city] has put you at odds with the [tribe]. Over time, an increasing number of their children have been arrested for petty crimes and sentenced to hard labor. The situation has slowly increased tensions and has now reached a boiling point, with [character] appearing in your Court and demanding an end to the practice. How shall we respond?

events.author: Zorbaz
events.name: Clearing His Debt

options.text: Ask that they make a sizeable donation to your coffers.
Ask that they help draft upcoming laws and mandates.
There is no need for repayment, it was for a friend!

events.text: [character] approaches you about clearing the debt that he owes you. He understands that you were a great supporter in his time of need, but now it is time to even the scales. What gift shall we accept to resolve this matter?

events.author: Gabe Campbell
events.name: Confused Loyalties

options.text: Encourage the [family] and the citizens of [city] to find common ground in their faith.
This affinity for foreign creeds makes me nervous. Expel these acolytes of [religion]!
The people and leaders of [city] are wise to embrace [religion]. Let us all convert!

events.text: The [family] ruling Family of [city] are [religion], just like the original [rival] inhabitants of the city. Some members of the court are concerned that [family] loyalties may now be torn between their faith and their nation. Expelling the remaining [rival] in the city may allay such concerns, but it would also greatly anger the [family], the [rival] and the [religion]. What is your decree?

events.author: Gabe Campbell
events.name: Council Dispute

options.text: I prefer the straightforward way that Chancellor [character] conducts his business.
Spymaster [character] is right. Bring the knives out!
There is room in our suite of diplomatic tools for both approaches.

events.text: Two of your Councilor are having a heated dispute over some of the finer matters of statecraft. The Chancellor [character] believes in the straight and narrow way of handling affairs. He would prefer to reach out with gifts and diplomatic missions when things go awry in important relationships, whereas your Spymaster [character] is known for his more... unorthodox approach. Both Councilor argue that you favor their style of diplomacy, and they confront you together in the royal palace, demanding that you publicly support one way or the other. Which Councilor do you favor?

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Council Swap

options.text: [character] needs more experience near the throne.
The composition of the Council is the ruler's responsibility.
I will make it up to the [family].

events.text: [character] corners you in the corridor outside court. You instruct your guards to stand down but remain cautious. The Heir, known to be wary of you, is not pleased with his place outside the Council. "Perhaps your close relationship with the [family] has blinded you. This can be remedied. Place me on the Council in place of [character]. I am the future of [rival]."

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Covert Marriage

options.text: Their love should be celebrated!
No, it is too late to stop this.
[character] will be branded an enemy of the state.

events.text: The messenger arrives before the sun has crept above the city edges, rousing the few palace servants who were not already up and at their duties. The message is from the [family] family, asking an urgent favor. The previous night [character] and [character] married in secret and against the wishes of the family. The [family] family ask that you brand [character] a fugitive for his actions so that [character] returns to them.

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: Dangerous Heirs

options.text: Conspiracies will not be tolerated.

events.text: Bitter that they were passed over in the royal succession, [character] and [character] are rumored to be plotting your demise. Of course, rumors are not always true...

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Daughter's Dream

options.text: Execute the father. A life for a life.
The father acted with pure intentions.
Compensate both for their suffering.

events.text: A local judge appeals to the court for a decision in a controversial dispute between a father and daughter. [character], who was with child, dreamt that she gave birth to a flood that swept away the city. Her father, [character], believing the dream prophetic, waited until the child was born and then killed it. How shall we rule?

events.author: Solver
events.name: Day of the Dupes

options.text: [character]'s service for [rival] is impeccable, I stand by him.
I can find another minister but not another father.
For the good of [rival], we can find a way to share power.

events.text: There have been easier times than these among those who rule [rival]. Your father [character] has long been uneasy about the influence that [character] exercises over state affairs. It seems he has been encouraged by [character]'s many rivals, and now [character] bursts into your chambers, demanding you fire [character], whom he refers to as a "valet" and "self-important servant". You have to make the choice between your father and your minister.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Deception and Chaos

options.text: One less honest man will help.
Maybe the head of [religion] should disappear.
Walk in and surprise them.

events.text: It doesn’t escape your attention when [character] and [character] slip away from the feast. You follow them out without a second thought and stay close behind. They are arguing in fast and furtive whispers, each theorizing about your deceptions. The one thing they seem to agree on is that you are obviously an agent of The Lie, an enemy to Ahura Mazda’s truth and a danger to [religion]. An agent of The Lie? Well if it’s chaos they want…

events.author: Gabe Campbell
events.name: Disinherit This!

options.text: Get [character] out of my sight! What a senseless tragedy.
I cannot bring myself to execute [character], but he is too dangerous to be free.
Only one punishment befits such a heinous crime.

events.text: In an act of shocking yet predictable treachery, your former heir [character] has murdered your current heir [character], who had bypassed him in the line of Succession on your order. Entirely lacking in subtlety, [character] struck down [character] in cold blood in front of the court. Standing over the body, he declares, "How's this for loyalty, [character]? No one dishonors me with impunity. I shall be the next king!" It is too late for this to be swept under the rug. Such a bold and frankly insane act by [character] simply gives you no choice in the matter. He must be gotten rid of by one means or another.

events.author: Gabe Campbell
events.name: Disinherited

options.text: Let us reconcile with [character].
I cannot bring myself to harm [character], but he is too dangerous to be free.
There's only one way to be be sure...

events.text: Your former heir [character], now bypassed in favor of [character], has been seething with resentment since his disinheritance. The rumor is that he may take drastic action soon to restore his place in the line of Succession! It may be wise to dispose of [character] before he does anything rash, but your spouse [character] will not forgive you for attempting to harm him. Perhaps there is still some chance to reconcile with [character] and hope that this all blows over? [character] and [character] stand ready to assist you though if need be...

events.author: David Ballantyne
events.name: Distant Riches: Proposal

options.text: A wonderful opportunity. Of course!
What can foreign lands offer [rival]? Begone!

events.text: A well-known explorer, Sataspes, has come to you with a most interesting offer. He says he knows of distant lands, rich with luxurious goods which are unknown here. If you will fund his expedition, he will secure a supply of their bounty for [rival]! “The journey will be long and hard,” explains Sataspes, “and I cannot know exactly how long it will take, but I am certain I will succeed!”

events.author: Velociryx
events.name: Drinking Buddies

options.text: Sure! All of this ruling business is boring, let's ride!
It pains me, but I must decline. I need to try and turn over a new leaf.

events.text: You and [character] have become friends in recent years and have spent a great many nights drinking and carousing. One fine afternoon, he rides to the city gates, a cask of stout ale strapped to his horse and invites you on a hunt. What say you?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: El, Yahweh and Baal

options.text: Maybe God is not the only divine being.
Baal may just be another name for God.
They must be corrected.

events.text: Many of the [tribe] have adopted the ways of [religion], but worrying reports are now reaching you. Their inscriptions give praise to God by his common names of El and Yahweh, but also call him Baal - the name of a pagan god. The teachings of [religion] are explicit that no other gods should be worshiped. How will you deal with this association with paganism?

events.author: Zorbaz
events.name: Era of Corruption

options.text: Do not interfere. What the poor don't know won't hurt them.
Double the sale of blessings. The divine's favor must be paid for, and we need the money.
We must change. These are eternal matters. We should not sell sins as if they were chattel.

events.text: Never in our history have the common people been so content, even as our nobles and priests rob them blind. The poorest of the kingdom spend their last silver on sacred images, while the wealthiest of merchants upstage each other in exhibitions of piety and vanity. Sacred murals and holy sculptures of unmatched size and color decorate the villas and palaces of the noble families, even as blessings are sold for every abominable sin and luxurious vice. All the while, unfathomable amounts of money flow into the royal coffers from these rightful dues and fees. How shall we protect this source of income and maintain our power over the people?

events.author: Zorbaz
events.name: Era of Guilds

options.text: We shall levy a tax upon the guilds.
We must negotiate for additional resource production.
We must uproot any examples of corruption within the guilds.

events.text: [rival] grows ever more powerful and prosperous due to the burgeoning guilds. The benefits are nearly uncountable, stabilizing wages, standardizing quality, and establishing reputable dealers for all manner of goods. Merchants, masons, tailors, sailors, navigators, glass-makers, bakers, dyers, divers, smiths, soldiers - the list grows by the decade! Our nation is in the throes of an economic boom such as has never been seen in history. How shall we strengthen our guilds?

events.author: Zorbaz
events.name: Era of Holy Wars

options.text: We must spread word of the faith to all lands!
We shall march forward by the sword!

events.text: Your armies fight with the impassioned zeal of true believers. They fight, bleed, and die with the unassailable faith of the righteous as they seek to bring down all the pompous fools and sinful nobles that blight the world, tainting what God created. No wall is too strong for your armies, no empire too distant! Praise God and slaughter his enemies!

events.author: Zorbaz
events.name: Era of Justice

options.text: True freedom is only found with equality of law!
We must ensure that these laws are publicly known.
There is still much work to be done!

events.text: Within [rival], none are above the law. The rules may be bent, but they are never broken. The nation rests in this knowledge as our courts deal justice and resolve disputes across the land. Indeed, we have entered an era of justice never before seen in the history of our nation. How shall we strengthen the law and ensure domestic tranquillity within the land?

events.author: Zorbaz
events.name: Era of Patriots

options.text: Sing the tales of our brave fighting men and women.
Call upon them to fight for our home once more!
Thank them for their service.

events.text: We stand upon the backs of giants, heroes one and all. The armies of [rival] swell in times of peril, gathering to generals such as [character] and [character] and granting us the strength needed to defeat our enemies. Our nation would not survive without the selfless sacrifice of our citizens, who lay down their career and pick up their spear, fighting through the fear for their children and their lands. How shall we celebrate these brave people?

events.author: Zorbaz
events.name: Era of Trade

options.text: We must tax this trade and secure our portion.
We shall invest in these merchant cities for future returns.
We must celebrate our accomplishments. Surely we can afford it!

events.text: Never in the history of [rival] has trade flowed so freely and wealth grown so precipitously. Hundreds, perhaps even thousands, of our ships ply the seaways, trading with distant lands and bringing untold luxuries and wealth to the nation. Our merchants are the envy of the world as they sail the seven seas. With each trade mission, our wealth and renown grow to heights unknown! How shall we strengthen our nation even further?

events.author: Zorbaz
events.name: Era of Universal [religion]

options.text: Let the faith and the law support each other as one.
Let royal inscriptions be made across the land enshrining these tenets in stone.
We will expand our faith even more, to even the furthest reaches.

events.text: We live in a momentous and auspicious era. Never before has our nation been so united in purpose, bound together by our common faith, [religion]. Total strangers know that they share this divine bond that transcends all mortal divides. Truly the tenets [religion] are universal, and it is our duty to spread it to those poor souls lost in the darkness of ignorance. How shall we strengthen our universal faith?
