events.author: Zorbaz
events.name: Era of the Gods

options.text: We shall offer sacrifices and secure the favor of the gods and their servants.
Bring a sacred lover to me. I have need of an successor blessed by the gods.
I shall consult with a priestess to find the will of the gods.

events.text: [religion] shrines cover the land, placed atop mighty hills and beneath sacred trees. Acolytes and shrine prostitutes tend to them, in matters both sacred and profane. The favor of a divine one might provide a child to the barren family, or the intercession of a spirit reader might change a bitter fate. As all are welcome within the shrines of the gods, how might we best use their services?

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: Family First

options.text: We will make him the new Chancellor.
He does not deserve a title.

events.text: Whispers in court indicate that your brother [character] expects a favorable position on the court. How shall we balance family and state? Should we displace the current Chancellor, [character]?

events.author: Gabe Campbell
events.name: Favored One

options.text: [rival] falls under the reign of a madman...

events.text: The perceived dishonor of being recently bypassed in favor of [character] on your orders seems to have driven [character] into a murderous rage! He approaches you on the palace steps. You watch him from the dais, then, before you can open your mouth he draws a long, curved blade and cuts both you and [character] down in cold blood. In your last agonizing moments you see [character] make short work of your favored heir, [character] and his beloved [character]. Standing over your mangled bodies, body soaked in fresh blood, [character] raises his face to the sky and cackles, "No one dishonors me with impunity. Now I shall be king!"

events.author: Gabe Campbell
events.name: Favored One

options.text: [rival] falls under the reign of a madman...

events.text: The perceived dishonor of being recently bypassed in favor of [character] on your orders seems to have driven [character] into a murderous rage! He approaches you on the palace steps. You watch him from the dais, then, before you can open your mouth he draws a long, curved blade and cuts both you and [character] down in cold blood. In your last agonizing moments you see [character] make short work of your favored heir, [character]. Standing over your mangled bodies, body soaked in fresh blood, [character] raises his face to the sky and cackles, "No one dishonors me with impunity. Now I shall be king!"

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Feel the Pressure

options.text: I will not bow to intimidation.
[law] is not worth the trouble.
I will persuade them of [law]'s merits with a speech.

events.text: It is no secret that the [family] dislike the current law of [law], going so far as to introduce debate to abandon it every single day in court. Therefore, it is troubling to see the jilted [character] taking up their cause. With [character]'s help, the [family] are pushing forcefully to have this law stripped and replaced by one of which they approve.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Fighting for the Divine

options.text: My blade belongs to.
I fight for [rival].

rewards.text: Gain trait: Sword of the Gods
tip: As general: +50% Unit Trait Modifier / Infantry
As general: Immune to Critical Hit

options.text: May bless my sword.

events.text: It has been a long march at the head of your forces. When your army stops to camp, you are surprised to find that [character] has arrived with his [religion] entourage. "You are a fine General, [character], but what guides your hand when you fight? Dedicate your blade to and fight in the [religion] name."

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Foolish Display

options.text: Scars build character, even one this ugly.
He is useless to us now.
Make a public display of our support.

events.text: While attempting to demonstrate Infantry Square tactics for a group of adoring young women, the heir [character] accidentally slashed himself with a sarissa's sharp iron head. The court physicians worry that he may not fully recover. Shall we prepare for a change in succession?

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Fresh Game

options.text: We will pay the [tribe] well for their catch.
Give the hunters a little extra, as a token of friendship.
Tell them to take their meat elsewhere.

events.text: Hunters from a nearby [tribe] encampment visit the palace, inquiring as to whether it has enough meat for its daily needs. They offer a surplus of recently caught venison for a generous price. The royal stewards admit that fresh game is always needed.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Haoma

options.text: My mind races with knowledge!
My heart overflows with song!
My body fills with strength!
My frailty is no more!

events.text: Milk mixed with the crushed leaves and sap of sacred plants. Along with the sacred fire the haoma juice is an essential part of the regular [religion] sacrifice rituals, representing the nourishing waters that support animals and plants alike. [character] hands you the clay bowl and watches as you drink deeply. The potent mixture rolls around your mouth, burning the back of your throat. It is said to grant the drinker power, healing, and inspiration. He is still watching. “How do you feel?”

events.author: Solver
events.name: Harem Conspiracy

options.text: I have little choice. [character] shall succeed me.
I will buy time to "consider" this while I order guards to imprison the plotters.

events.text: There was a conspiracy brooding right here in the palace! Yet the first you find out about it is now, as your own chancellor and your husband confront you in your bedchamber. [character] and Chancellor [character] tell you, without the faintest pretense of respect, that they consider [character], your heir, to be unacceptable as a future ruler. They demand that you name [character] as the heir instead, or your own rule will end prematurely.

events.author: Dale Kent
events.name: Ides of March

options.text: Et tu parvuli?

events.text: It is a warm March day as you attend a meeting of the Senate at the Theatre of Pompey. The sun is warm, the breeze moves the banners and you watch eagles soaring up high. You lazily listen to the Senators discuss produce levels and market demands. Suddenly a furtive movement to your left rouses you, [character] confronts you angrily with other members of the [family] family. You hear the words "betrayer" as knives come from every direction. Their attack is over as fast as it began. You stagger to your knees bleeding from what seems a thousand cuts. [character] plunges his knife into your belly as you mutter your last words.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Illumination

options.text: These are the one true teachings.
I wish to hear from more voices.

events.text: An elder of the [religion] church claims to have been touched by the hand of the divine, and he suffers an illumination of the mind. Inspired, he produces a collection of writings to be taught to the people. Members of the [family] family urge us to adopt these teachings and recognize the revelations at hand.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Imperfect Made Perfect

options.text: Do not lecture a [title].
Very well, this feud is over.

events.text: Your strained relationship with [character] has been the cause of much distress in the court, and [character] has taken it upon himself to intervene by sending a message about humility and forgiveness that is read out in court. “It is only through living for the ideals of asha, those of truth and goodness, that humanity can work together and get closer to perfection.” [character] looks to you. Is it the true and good thing to forgive him?

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: In Your Debt

options.text: Promise improvements to their city.
We will give favors in court affairs.
He may marry into my family.

events.text: Our relationship with [character] of the [family] family has been decaying for months, but luckily we have allies. [character], who claims to owe you a favor has volunteered to entreat with [character] on our behalf. He believes that the rift can be healed with some deft diplomacy. How shall we tell him to proceed?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: In the Wrong Hands

options.text: Curses! We must stay vigilant!

events.text: Our bitter enemies, the [rival], have struck another blow. One of their agents managed to slip into the capital unnoticed, stealing our research before fleeing back to [character]. Although the spy was killed by our guards while trying to escape across the border, the stolen research was recovered by [rival] troops.

events.author: Solver
events.name: Inappropriate Faith

options.text: Could a contribution to [family] coffers help them overlook historical pride?
We must repent and not force [religion] on those who would rather worship Ra.
The [family] family needs to be convinced that [religion] is the true faith.

events.text: Once upon a time, all people of Egypt worshipped Osiris, Ra and Horus. Those days are no more, as [religion] has been decreed to be the faith of the land. A representative of the [family] family stands before you. The family believes it's completely inappropriate for us to mandate [religion] of all faiths, which teaches that we, the wise Egypt, once kept their ancestors as slaves and mistreated them. It is also taught that our Pharaoh, who with Ra's blessing had great might and compassion, was a cruel man whose pride brought scourge upon the holy lands of Egypt. For you to be worthy of the title of Pharaoh yourself, you must renounce [religion], the man before you claims. How shall you respond to these demands?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Jachin and Boaz

options.text: Ask to hear more about Jachin’s travels.
Boaz the judge sounds interesting.
Decline and proceed inside.

events.text: The twin pillars of Jachin and Boaz stand outside of Holy Site Judaism, their bronze surfaces gleaming in the sun. [character] walks beside you through [city] as you make your way to the temple and you fall into conversation about the pillars’ namesakes. Jachin was a son of Simeon who migrated across the lands, Boaz a pious judge and the husband of Ruth. [character] asks if you want to learn more about either of these [religion] figures?

events.author: Solver
events.name: Keeping Up Appearances

options.text: If that's what it takes for [character] to be happy.
Though I understand that this is difficult, appearances come before our personal lives.
That would disappoint [character]. But not if he is dead.

events.text: During your evening stroll in the royal gardens, [character] approaches you, wearing a solemn expression. [character] is unhappy in his marriage to [character]. They both understand the importance of keeping up appearances as royals, but this has weighed too heavily on [character]. He says he trusts you and would like your blessing to divorce [character], and perhaps be happily together with a man one day.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Leaders or Lunatics?

options.text: We must restore the sacred glory of [rival]!
Let them search, so long as they do their jobs.
Remove [character]. He can meditate elsewhere.

events.text: A recent visit to the council of [city] worries us. Its members, including Governor [character], has adopted a strange form of meditation, denying themselves basic pleasures in a quest for inner peace. Emaciated and wild-eyed, they have gone without food or water for days. It appears our laws have reduced some of our leaders to lunatics.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Legacy of Gold

options.text: Remove both from their positions.
Teach [character] the meaning of wealth.
Remove [character] as an influence.

events.text: We have overheard the heir, [character], and the Chancellor, [character], secretly discussing their plans for the vast fortune we have amassed during your time as ruler. Unfortunately there is little we can do about what happens after your reign... Or is there?

events.author: David Ballantyne
events.name: Let Sleeping Rulers Lie

options.text: Grunt ambiguously and go back to sleep.

events.text: You are sound asleep when suddenly one of your advisors bursts into your chambers shouting something about a predicted flood which is likely to sweep much of [city] away. They urgently request that you authorize the city labor force to dig some emergency ditches and construct a series of dykes. It sounds dreadfully bothersome, can’t they see you are otherwise engaged?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Letter of Treason

options.text: Lay the traps, [character] will not escape!
Make the edits so that [character] rises up against [rival].
Pretend like we know nothing, and use the information to be one step ahead.

events.text: Your spies have intercepted a message from [character] to one of his faithful generals, [character]. The message details the location of [character] next attack. Schemes start to form. You could make sure the message reaches [character] and send your trappers to lay an ambush, or you could edit the message to make it seem like the general is being accused of treason, leading to a rebellion in [city].

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Lines in the Sand

options.text: They shall get the food they need. Send out the patrols.
Tell the patrols to focus on watching for threats.

rewards.text: Gain trait: Commander of the BorderLands

options.text: Appoint [character] as the Commander Border Forts.

events.text: The forts around [city] have become important centers for controlling the surrounding lands. With a well supplied base of operations, a light mobile force can secure a large area of land effectively. [character] asks for extra food to be supplied to these forts to increase the local patrols.

events.author: Gabe Campbell
events.name: Locals in Uproar

options.text: I won't tolerate disobedience. Get rid of this foreign rabble!
Let us reconcile with the native inhabitants of [city] through gift giving.

events.text: The original [rival] citizens of [city] are unhappy living under a foreign yoke. They resent everything about [rival] rule, and openly deride our government. Their Discontent is threatening to get out of control, and may soon lead to rebellions. We could mollify the anger of the [rival] citizens with gifts of gold, or exile them and be rid of this menace. How will you resolve this issue with your new subjects?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Lovers Steal Away

options.text: Get those fools back here!
We can only hope that they will return to [rival].

events.text: The servant quails before your gaze. Haltingly, he repeats the message left by [character] and [character], that they refuse to be parted any longer and have eloped together. There may still be time to get them back before they are too far gone, if you can spare the people to search.

events.author: David Ballantyne
events.name: Making “Amends”

options.text: Nothing can go wrong with this plan!

events.text: [character] is disappointed with your recent actions, but there’s a simple solution to that. Tell them you are sorry and will change your ways. If they discover your falsehoods? Tell more lies! Here he comes now. “[character], please forgive me. I know I hurt you, I treated you poorly and that was wrong of me. I acted in a most unkingly manner.” He looks into your eyes for several moments, clearly thinking intently, before replying. “Very well, [character], you seem genuinely sorry and I’m willing to give you another chance. Don’t make me regret it”

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Medical Aid

options.text: It is only right to pay.
Refuse to pay.
These herbs will 'ease his pain'...

events.text: After a particularly heated debate, [character] tried to fight you to avenge his grievances. You quickly struck him down. Although alive, [character] has been left needing intense medical attention. The laws of [religion] state that it is the duty of a person to pay for the treatment of someone that they have wounded in a fight. What will you do?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Name of the Murderer

options.text: Imprison [character] for these accusations.
I will not be bated into rash action by this young fool.
Silence him.

events.text: The crowd outside of the palace clamor and shout, raging against the guards who stand protecting the gates. At their head, [character] stands on a hastily constructed podium, whipping the crowd to a frenzy. An advisor comes up to you. "It appears that [character] is openly claiming that you had his father [character] assassinated and is counting on the support of the people for protection." If the families find out about this they will be horrified, but taking [character] will anger the people. How will you act?

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: New Obsession

options.text: Support [character] in his efforts.
Set aside land for this national monument.
Our priorities lie elsewhere.

events.text: After seeing his first vaulted ceiling, the heir, [character], has become fixated on building a massive domed structure as a memorial to the great [character]. This desire borders on obsession. We do not wish to quarrel with him but such an undertaking would take many years and resources to complete.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: No Small Favor

options.text: I will help [character] this once.
[character] must improve his leadership.

events.text: News from [city] is grim. The people are unhappy and threaten revolt. [city]'s Governor, your brother [character], begs for assistance, claiming that the discontent is not his fault. [character] lays out a plan for the turnaround of [city], but will it be enough? This is not the first time he has needed your help.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Nowruz

options.text: Make a toast celebrating the noble families.
Reward [character] for his words.
Keep the celebrations going all night!

events.text: Of the seven annual [religion] feasts, it falls on you to host Nowruz. The great feast to honor Ahura Mazda is a suitably grand occasion. After the standard rituals and worship wine flows freely and many toasts are made. [character] makes an especially fine speech about your leadership and power that impresses all present.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Offensive Behavior

options.text: Remove [character] at once!
He is too crucial to our plans.

events.text: Whispers in the court describe the crude and unbecoming behavior of the great soldier [character]. Although you have not seen these incidents with your own eyes, they are not difficult to imagine. Perhaps it is time to release [character] from his duties.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: On their Own

options.text: Vassalage has been a terrible failure, and it must be remedied.
Remove [character] and uses his riches to feed the people.
The government shall distribute a food subsidy.

events.text: [city] teeters on the brink of starvation, and the corrupt [character] appears to care nothing for the people of his city. The court has dedicated itself to a policy of Vassalage, but some are beginning to regret their stance. Especially as cities wither on their own. Several options are available to us, though none is without risk.

events.author: David Ballantyne
events.name: Only the Best

options.text: Disgusting!

events.text: The state banquet hosted by [character] is proceeding passably well when you are suddenly served the most unacceptable wine. It is entirely the wrong shade of red, a mere deep burgundy, not the dark ruby that you prefer. Despite protests by [character] that it is a rare vintage imported at great cost, you declare it swill not fit for pigs and order the entire supply thrown out! He seems rather upset with you.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Out For Blood

options.text: I will not give [character] the chance to strike.
We will wait for a better opportunity.

events.text: Your spymaster [character] has sent a warning: His agents have discovered that [character] has uncovered your involvement in the assassination of his father [character] and is planning to take revenge. Be on guard!

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Paying for the Sacrifice

options.text: Zoroaster’s teachings should not be distracted by material pay.
The blessings of Ahura Mazda are worth the extra gold.
A royal donation will offset the debasement.

events.text: The introduction of Coin Debasement has had an unintended consequence in your realm. [character] has encouraged the [religion] Magi to drastically raise the prices of their rituals, arguing that the reduced amount of pure gold within the coins make them less worthy to Ahura Mazda. This has angered the noble houses, who regularly patron such rituals. Is this base profiteering or a sacred cause?

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Persecution in [city]

options.text: I will rebuild relations with [character].
Pass laws prohibiting persecution.
Convert him to [religion].

events.text: [religion] priests in the city of [city] have come seeking the court's intervention. They report that [character] has mounted a deliberate campaign to target their religion, stripping basic rights and supporting laws that persecute its followers. We believe this may be retaliation against you for past slights. Therefore, it is our responsibility to act.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Pilgrimage for Ahura Mazda

options.text: This will bring us closer to Ahura Mazda.
I don't have time for a pilgrimage.

events.text: A nearby peak has become a popular pilgrimage site for the [religion], who travel with animals to sacrifice them to Ahura Mazda. [character] has invited you to go on a pilgrimage with him to give an offering to the god. Do you travel to seek out the divine?

events.author: Gabe Campbell
events.name: Pilgrimage to The Holy City

tip: As leader: +5% State Religion Spread Chance

options.text: Let us set out on a royal pilgrimage to the Holy City of [city]!
The wise man stays at home.

events.text: You have felt a longing recently to reconnect with [religion]. You've become intrigued by the possibility of going on a pilgrimage to visit the Holy City of [city]. Shall you set out on a pilgrimage to Holy [city]?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Preparing the Sacrifice

options.text: Vohu Manah, ‘good thought’
Asha Vahishta, ‘best order’
Khshathra Vairiya, ‘well deserved command’
Now is not the time.

events.text: [character] has asked for you to be the patron for an upcoming sacrifice. As with all such [religion] rituals it must be dedicated to a specific god, but he is having a difficult time deciding which of the life-giving immortals should be worshiped. Each entity embodies an ideal state. Perhaps dedicating yourself to one would help you improve as a ruler?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Preparing the Sacrifice

options.text: Spenta Armati, ‘life-giving humility’
Haurwatat, ‘wholeness’
Amertatat, ‘longevity’
Now is not the time.

events.text: [character] has asked for you to be the patron for an upcoming sacrifice. As with all such [religion] rituals it must be dedicated to a specific god, but he is having a difficult time deciding which of the life-giving immortals should be worshiped. Each entity embodies an ideal state. Perhaps dedicating yourself to one would help you improve as a ruler?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Pressure from [religion]

options.text: You have no power here, [character].
If that is will, then so be it.
Maybe [character] should replace [character] instead?

events.text: [character] comes before your court in full splendor with a large procession of and holy warriors. He loudly demands that you abdicate the throne to your heir [character], a true follower of [religion]. Shocked murmurs spread through the court. Although [character] has no real power over [rival], the supporters of [religion] must be angry indeed for him to feel so emboldened. Will you cave to this demand?

events.author: Solver
events.name: Purim

options.text: Ban this festival. No religion may insult Persia!
Purim is when [religion] tell stories about a long forgotten advisor and get drunk? Sounds fun!

events.text: The citizens of [city] are outraged by some religious practices of [religion]. It turns out that [religion] celebrate a festival called Purim, which is all about being saved from a cruel Persian king and his murderous vizier. Many in [city] feel it's a step too far for a Persian city to allow celebrations that make us into the villain. Even if [religion] is not the faith of our people, it's becoming a more prominent part of the culture in [city].

events.author: Zorbaz
events.name: Reign by Whips and Chains

options.text: Deal harshly with our two most troublesome Cities.
We must end this abhorrent practice.

events.text: Your slaves fill the court with the constant and reassuring sound of rattling chains. There are slaves for every need - the solution to all of life's distasteful duties. They build your Improvement, grow your nation's Food, and labor in the dank Mine and Quarry. Yes, all is as it should be. But there is one great, irrational fear that keeps you awake at night. A dream of the chained masses rising from the mire to drag you screaming from the throne.

events.author: Zorbaz
events.name: Reign of Carnality

options.text: We shall leave a legacy that even the gods would blush at.
No, this path is too expensive and leads only to discord.

events.text: Pleasing music and the dusky scent of incense fills the air. [character] dances for you and [character] as wine is passed about the banquet. Courtiers lay entangled among each other, entrapped in the throes of delight and the press of flesh. Even [character] is taking part in the many pleasures. Truly, this party has been one for the ages and there will be many more of them in the years to come. Historians will undoubtedly write of your debauched rule in slack-jawed awe.

events.author: Zorbaz
events.name: Reign of Decadence

options.text: The court shall embrace the thrill of this life.
We must consider the needs of the people.
Let us make sure I control all the dens of depravity and vice.

events.text: The court of [rival] spends untold sums cavorting each and every night, lavishing every whim and desire upon themselves. No debauchery is too extravagant and no desire is left unfulfilled. The court writhes with a pleasure that has never been seen before in the history of our nation. The other nations look on aghast at our flagrant depravity and shake their fists at the gods, begging them to destroy us. But for us, there is only the pleasure of the next carousal as we laugh at their prudish nature and indulge in the delights of love, life, and luxury.

events.author: Solver
events.name: Religious Uprising

options.text: What are they going to do, fight us?
Our laws are too strict, [religion] also has a place in [rival].
How dare they question the supremacy of [religion]!

events.text: The [religion] faithful in [city] have long been unhappy with [religion] being the State Religion, but now they claim that our orthodox policies are oppressing [religion]. Some go as far as to say that [religion] are in danger in [rival] and must resort to defending themselves. Their demands for religious freedom are threatening to shut down much of [city] and we cannot delay responding.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Returning the Favor

options.text: Accept [character] as Ambassador.
No, [character] asks too much.

events.text: You are preparing to meet a group of foreign dignitaries at court, when you hear that [character] has been showing them the sites of the city, a role normally reserved for the Ambassador. Confronting [character] later, he reminds you that you still owe him a favor and asks that you appoint him to the role. Shall we make [character] the new Ambassador, or will the title remain with [character]?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Returning the Favor

options.text: Accept, [character] will be the new Chancellor.
No, [character] asks too much.

events.text: [character] has sent a messenger to inform you that he has a way for you to return the favor that you owe, by appointing him the Chancellor of [rival]. [character] argues that he is well suited for the role and believes that he would do a better job than [character]. This is a high position and the current Chancellor [character] will not be happy at being displaced. Shall we accept [character]’s demand?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Returning the Favor

options.text: Let’s be done with this.
No, [character] asks too much.

events.text: A messenger arrives from [character], requesting that [rival] make a financial donation to [religion]. He pointedly reminds you of the favor that he provided for you previously and claims that this will help to strengthen the worshipers of. Will you accept this demand?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Returning the Favor

options.text: Make [character] the Governor of [city].
No, [character] asks too much.

events.text: [character] has sent you a worried message, claiming that [character] was asking pointed questions about the way the [city] was being run on a recent visit to the city. Sure enough, an audience with [character] soon follows in which he claims that [character] is failing in his duties, and asks to be installed as the new Governor of [city]. As you owe [character] a favor, this could be the ideal opportunity to settle the debt. However, doing so would likely make an enemy of [character].

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Returning the Favor

options.text: We will see what we can do.
No, [character] asks too much.

events.text: [character] has asked to meet. Reminding you of the favor that you owe, he proposes a plan to install himself as the Head of [religion]. Having an indebted subject at the head of your State Religion could be very useful, but it is not a role that you are in a position to directly hand out. Attempting this could end up damaging your relationship with [religion]. Is it worth the risk?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Returning the Favor

options.text: Serve me well, [character].
No, [character] asks too much.

events.text: [character] slides out of the shadows and speaks to you in a hushed whisper. “Do you remember that favor, my [title]? Well I’m collecting. Make me the Spymaster of [rival] and I will count the debt paid.” [character] could be an interesting candidate, but appointing him will inevitably upset [character]. Should we accept [character]’s proposal?

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Riding Contest

options.text: I must politely refuse.
We ride!
The [title] of [rival] in a barbarian contest? Never.

events.text: Your reputation as a master rider has aroused interest from the [tribe]. They desire to see the [title] who is said to be "half horse." They organize a series of trials and races showcasing every rider's skill. Even the [tribe] leader, [character] will ride. He has personally requested your participation.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Rival Successors

options.text: My decision is final, [character] will rule after me.
[character] is right, [character] must be excluded from the line of succession.

events.text: Battle lines are being drawn in the capital; [relative] [character] has been loudly protesting that your heir [character] is adopted, playing on people’s base fears and arguing that his claim to the leadership of [rival] is far stronger than [character]’s. The [family] family has risen in support of [character], while the [family] family remain loyal to [character]. Arguments over succession have been the end of many a nation, the fierce tension rising over your successor demands a swift response to resolve the matter.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: River Revelation

options.text: What an amazing story! [character] is surely blessed.
Don’t waste my time with such lies.
[character] has been called. He should be the new head of [religion].

events.text: Following the recent [religion] Spring festival of Maidhyoi-shema, rumors have been swirling around that [character] has received a revelation through Ahura Mazda in the same way as Zoroaster himself. Apparently [character] was fetching water from the river for the celebrations. As he emerged purified from the river he saw a vision of Vohu Manah as a being of light, who led him to Ahura Mazda and the divine six. On the other hand, [character] believes [character] is lying and this is merely an attempt to usurp his position Could [character] be telling the truth?

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Rogue Nation

options.text: We have chosen to let vassals wield authority.
Emissaries must be sent to confront [character].

requirements.label: Schemer / Ruthless
tip: The leader must have one of: Schemer; Ruthless

options.text: Pay local ruffians to rid us of this "problem."

events.text: Waves of unhappy citizens arrive in [city] from [city], searching for a better life. According to their stories, [character] has started governing his city like a small empire, requiring total loyalty from the court and military. Perhaps it is time for the true [rival] court to step in and prevent additional tensions.

events.author: Gabe Campbell
events.name: Royal Pilgrimage

options.text: Let us set out on a royal pilgrimage to the Holy City of [city]!
The wise man stays at home.

events.text: You have felt alienated from [religion] lately, tired of the regular rituals and discourse. However, after a chance meeting with a pilgrim, you become intrigued by the possibility of going on a pilgrimage to visit the Holy City of [city] to try and rekindle the flame of your faith. Shall you set out on a pilgrimage to [city]?

events.author: Zorbaz
events.name: Rule of Law

options.text: Yes, they shall set an example for all future governors.
No, they are needed at court for other matters.

events.text: Under your rule, both nobles and commoners are at peace and unified in their pursuit of justice. There has never been such a time of success and harmony in the history of [rival]. Surely people will look back upon these years as a golden age for the Rule of Law. Two nobles are especially loved for their virtues, [character] and [character]. Shall we reward them with governorships and set an example for future governors?

events.author: Solver
events.name: Saved in the Last Hour

rewards.text: Gain trait: Savior of the Throne

options.text: I am happy to grant [character]'s request, with my gratitude.
Perhaps erecting a statue of [character] in [city] would be an appropriate gesture.
This is madness! I cannot have a spymaster killing random people.

events.text: Your spymaster [character] comes rushing into the throne room, all decorum forgotten, to reveal very important news. [character] has overheard [character] plotting to murder you! Even though [character] spoke in code, the meaning did not evade your vigilant spymaster. "Plowing the fields" was code for the assassination itself, and the plotters were careful to only refer to you as "someone". Just hours ago, [character] said "time for dinner", meaning the attempt on your life was imminent! Not to worry, [character] took care of the plot personally. He believes that, for saving you at the last moment, an extra payment is warranted. It is a lot to ask of course, but [character] would like to be named Savior of the Throne. And to have a bowl of fruit.

events.author: Zorbaz
events.name: Sic Temper Tyrannis

options.text: Into the dark.

events.text: As you enjoy a day at the theater, a messenger enters your royal booth. The man steps up beside you, and with a flourish draws a scroll. You indicate for him to read the message and turn back to the entertainment. The flash of metal catches your eye too late. The dagger hidden within the scroll already in the assassin’s hand and an overwhelming flash of pain blinds you as the metal catches in your neck. You are faintly aware of the assassin grappling with your bodyguard, then leaping from the seating and onto the stage. "Thus always to Tyrants!" the assassin bellows, as you collapse, blood running endlessly from the mortal wound. Was this the revenge of [character] or a political renegade? The question slips away as darkness takes you into her chilled embrace.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Sins of the Past

options.text: The darkness closes in...

events.text: You are alone in your chambers, the weight of a long day sitting heavily on your sholders. But there is something wrong. You become aware of that the moment that you sip your drink and all of the weight disappears. All feeling disappears. [character] calmly walks out from behind a pillar and studies your unmoving face. "I have been waiting for this, old man. Your agents weren't as careful as they thought, when they killed my father, [character]. I just wanted you to know that he has revenge through me. Farewell [character], may the gods judge you as you deserve."

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Special Status

options.text: Grant the city special status as a center of trade.
No more corruption. No more broken trade.
Our greatest merchants will meet to share knowledge.

events.text: The elders of [city] struggle with worsening finances, as Governor [character] claims that the royal court is restricting the city's opportunities. "We are a center of trade and industry," he explains. "But we are passed over for special status because of royal corruption." [character] and the local politicians urge us to grant [city] special status, opening up new avenues of revenue and trade.

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: Spymaster Candidates

options.text: Choose [character].
Choose [character].
I will make my own decisions!

events.text: The [family] and [family] families both claim to have ideal candidates for the open position of spymaster. It would be good to fill the role, but should we worry that so many noble families produce devious, cutthroat individuals? Which should we choose?

events.author: David Ballantyne
events.name: Surprise Attack!

options.text: A struggle ensues!

events.text: As you walk along a quiet corridor, a figure suddenly steps out from the shadows and strikes you with a club! You stagger, but do not fall, and turn to face your attacker.

events.author: David Ballantyne
events.name: Surprise Attack!

options.text: How strange!

events.text: You are enjoying a quiet glass of wine in your room, but as you drain the last of it you notice a strange, bitter aftertaste…

events.author: David Ballantyne
events.name: Surprise Attack!

options.text: What the?!

events.text: While strolling through a garden, a flicker of motion in your peripheral vision catches your attention!

events.author: David Ballantyne
events.name: Surprise Attack!

options.text: What the?!

events.text: Retiring to bed, you slip beneath your sheets and find a comfortable position. Your rest is rudely interrupted by the feeling of a scaled body slithering against your leg!

events.author: David Ballantyne
events.name: Surprise Attack!

options.text: I try to dodge!

events.text: As you make your way down an underused passageway, you are startled by a knife-wielding figure suddenly lunging at you! You only have a moment to react!

events.author: David Ballantyne
events.name: Surprise Attack!

options.text: A struggle ensues!

events.text: Relaxing for a moment, you lean back against a wall. You have only a moment to be surprised by the faint click of a hidden hatch opening behind you before a silk cord is around your neck!

events.author: Jeri Roys
events.name: Taking Up a Hobby

options.text: A masterstroke! Dearest, clearly your talents were being wasted on inconsequential trivialities.
Dearest, isn't this a little... drastic?

events.text: The idleness of court seems to be taking its toll on [character], with more and more long evenings spent brooding. So you were delighted when some spring returned to his step working on some kind of project with [character]. After a few weeks away on "errands", [character] returns with a smile on his face and some bulky baggage that two guards struggle to carry. "Beloved, I think I have finally found a way to keep those perfidious [rival] in their place." Inside the luggage is a young member of the [rival] court, known as a favorite of their ruler.

events.author: JoshUnsworth
events.name: Temple Market

options.text: Create a market for the whole City.
Let the market grow naturally.

events.text: A makeshift market has sprung up around the temple of [city], selling animals for [religion] worshipers to take in and sacrifice. However, it is now spilling onto main streets and disrupting the entire area. [character] suggests that the market should be moved and expanded to serve the entire city, but the faithful won't like losing their exclusive access.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Temple and State

options.text: Adopt the ways of [religion].
It doesn’t matter what I believe.

events.text: [character] has confronted you about your lack of faith. He argues that with [religion] as the State Religion of [rival], it is vital that you be seen as a practitioner to provide stability and support to the faithful.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: The Army of Slaves

options.text: Use this chance to gain the support of the discontent [family].
We must stop this threat quickly.

events.text: The [family] Family have been struggling to recruit new soldiers for our armies, being repeatedly told that too many of the able-bodied men of [city] have been enslaved. Trying to work around this, [character] decreed that no one from their lands should be enslaved. The outrage was immediate. Rage grew amongst those not given their freedom, and the other [family] nobles were infuriated by the loss of their slaves. Alarmed, [character] quickly recants the decree. This time the violence is worse. The slaves, promised freedom only to have it snatched away, have taken up arms, killing their masters and fleeing to the lands around [city]. They have appointed [character] as their leader, once [character]’s personal musician.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: The Divine Priest

options.text: Praise him as a god of faith and guidance.
Make him the patron of your family, a god of righteous rule.
Zoroaster was a great man, but just a man.

events.text: Zoroaster is already exalted as the first priest, the first warrior, the first herdsman, master and judge of the world. With the growth of Mythology within [religion], the [family] family are starting to go beyond the words of the Avesta and have started worshiping Zoroaster as an Avestan god, offering him sacrifices and telling stories of how he was always a divine agent of Ahura Mazda. Will you ratify these new practices?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: The Final Fight

options.text: I must fight for a better world.
I cannot continue this fight anymore. I will forge my own path.
I am the Saoshyant!

events.text: Every day as a [religion] is a fight, a struggle to aid Ahura Mazda. It can be tiring. Conferring with [character], he reminds you that it is not forever. Zoroaster told that one day soon the Saoshyant will be born, one who will lead the final fight against the being of chaos Angra Mainyu and bring the world to victory. Then the world will finally be the perfect state that was envisioned at its creation. He is staring at you intently. How will you respond?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: The Founding Avestan

options.text: Yes, my line can be traced back to Zoroaster.
No, but we try to emulate the prophet’s ways.

events.text: Your servants bring news that a delegation from the [family] Family, including [character], has arrived at the palace to meet you. When you appear before them in full ritual splendor, you notice that they appear to avert their eyes with even more reverence than normal. [character] answers your questioning gaze. He explains that the ideals of [religion] Veneration have led to the spreading belief that your ancestor was a descendant of Zoroaster, if not Zoroaster himself reborn. The [family] want to host a feast to celebrate your ancestry.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: The Heir's Cup

options.text: Accept the cup.
Refuse the cup.

events.text: You celebrate another year, feasting with your family at your feet. The rightful heir, [character], offers you a drink from his cup, a chalice brimming with wine. Toasting his health will help to show support for your successor... even if you do not believe he is up to the task.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: The Judge, Mithra

options.text: Ask [character] to teach you more about Mithra.
I only need him to inspire my armies.

events.text: The increase of Legalism within [religion] has seen a shift in the worship of the god Mithra. Traditionally seen as both a warrior and a judge, his combative aspects are gradually being forgotten. As the guardian god of deals between mortals, [character] suggests that he would be a good figure to model your rule on.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: The Lost Scrolls

options.text: Send a team to find the scrolls.
It is a tragedy, but they are lost to us.

events.text: Tragedy has struck. A great haul of [religion] scrolls has been lost while being transported to [city]. It is unknown if it was a storm or bandits, but no sign of the scrolls or the porters charged with carrying them remains. Your advisors suggest that it could be possible to track the scrolls down, but doing so would come at a great expense and effort.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: The One Who Would be King

options.text: Leave it to the [family].
We must stop this threat quickly.

events.text: For years, a common entertainment at [family] parties has been to receive prophesies from the slave [character]. As the guest takes his hand, [character] spits fire from the mouth as the divine words flow through him. When asked where such powers come from, he claims to receive visions from a local pagan goddess, one who whispers he will one day be king. The [family] no longer find these statements so amusing. In a violent struggle, hundreds of slaves in [city] have risen up after years of unrest, killing their masters and taking to the surrounding countryside. Their leader is none other than [character], now a self-crowned king. Furious and seeking revenge, the [family] claim that there is nothing to fear and that they will handle the situation themselves. How shall we respond?

events.author: Gabe Campbell
events.name: The Pretender

options.text: [rival] falls under the reign of a pretender...

events.text: While on an evening stroll through the city, your bodyguard just behind you, a rotten cabbage strikes you in the face. Stunned, you look about to find the culprit, when a swarm of angry peasants suddenly materializes and begins pelting you with animal dung and rotting vegetables, decrying you for alleged heresies. Your own guard comes, seemingly to your aid, only to shackle your feet and gag you. They drag you back to the court where you see [character], whom you bypassed in the line of Succession, seated upon your throne! The guards throw you to your knees. "The good people of [rival] have tolerated your foul heresies for too long! I will relieve them of your treacherous rule. As for you, such shame should be kept out of sight." The guards throw a sackcloth over your head and load you into a prison carriage. They drive you for some time to the further flung borders of [rival]. There, you are unceremoniously dumped on the road and informed of your banishment.

events.author: Gabe Campbell
events.name: The Pretender

options.text: [rival] falls under the reign of a pretender...

events.text: As you are about to go to sleep, [character], whom you bypassed in the line of Succession, storms into your chambers, a troop of armed men in tow. "Your worthless rump has sat upon the throne too long [character]. Everyone knows I should have been named king!" The men drag you away into a squalid dungeon. Days pass by before you speak to anyone, or are even fed, but eventually news reaches you that [character] has fabricated charges of heresy and witchcraft of the foulest kind against you and staged a coup to install himself as king! You waste your days away in darkness...

events.author: Gabe Campbell
events.name: The Pretender

options.text: [rival] falls under the reign of a madman...

events.text: [character], whom you bypassed in the line of Succession, approaches you on the palace steps. You stop to address him, but before you can say a word he draws a long, curved blade and cuts you down in cold blood. In your last agonizing moments, as the red veil draws over your face, you see a look of sheer insanity in [character] eyes. You expire. Standing over your mangled body, face caked in fresh blood, [character] cackles "No one dishonors me with impunity. Now I shall be king!"

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: The Progression of Love

options.text: An interesting development.
Convince him that [character]'s feelings aren't real.

events.text: Throughout your conversation [character] seems constantly distracted, looking away and replying with monosyllabic answers. It is only when you happen to bring up [character] that he pays attention, suddenly hanging onto your every word. Through careful probing, you discover that the two friends have been growing closer recently and that there are further feelings developing the two of them.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: The Protege

options.text: I must spend more time with [character].
If we win the heir's family, we win the heir.
This requires drastic measures.
The court has more important concerns.

events.text: Certain members of the court are concerned about the behavior of [character], who has taken the heir under his wing. The impressionable [character] views you favorably, but we worry that his mind is being poisoned against us. Shall we step in and prevent [character] from exerting influence?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: The Rebel Writer

options.text: Execute him. [character] will never be king.
Allow the general to go free.
Give the man a trial.

events.text: Amid the discontent in [city], guards capture a rebel leader, a learned [religion] general and writer. When brought before the court, he boldly declares that God has shown him a sign that [character] will one day lead [rival]. Your heir [character] is furious and demands the man's head, but [character] has a thoughtful look and remains quiet.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: The Right Price

options.text: Remind [character] of what happens to those who betray me.
Promise him that I can match any offer that the [rival] make.
He must be watched carefully.

events.text: Your agent [character] has failed to make contact for over a month. Worried of the implications this could have, the agent network in [city] is tasked with finding him. They soon return with news that the [rival] managed to discover [character] and have made contact with him, using <p.is_sub.S0=SUBJECT_CORRUPT>a hefty bribe<p=SUBJECT_GREEDY>the promise of wealth<p=SUBJECT_BLOODTHIRSTY>the promise of violence<p=SUBJECT_RUTHLESS>an additional sum for betrayal<p=SUBJECT_DECEITFUL>the pleasure of betrayal<else>a hefty bribe<end> to appeal to his <p.is_sub.S0=SUBJECT_CORRUPT>corrupt<p=SUBJECT_GREEDY>greedy<p=SUBJECT_BLOODTHIRSTY>bloodthirsty<p=SUBJECT_RUTHLESS>ruthless<p=SUBJECT_DECEITFUL>deceitful<else>villainous<end> nature. The deal is not yet complete. Shall we intervene to prevent this possible treachery?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: The Weight of Debt

options.text: Our smiths will forge him a great weapon.
Set our scholars to write him a book of great works.
Send servants with as much gold as they can carry.
I will carry this burden a little longer.

events.text: Your debt to [character] weighs heavily on you. For a [religion] to owe a debt to any but Ahura Mazda is a disgrace. If word of this spreads it would drastically affect your reputation. Perhaps you could repay [character] with a gift?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: The Zurvanites

options.text: This is heresy and shall be treated as such.
Wait and see if Zurvanism spreads naturally.
Encourage the myth of the twin deities.

events.text: [religion] orthodoxy teaches that Ahura Mazda was the original being and that all others were created through him. However, the [family] Family have adopted a different line of thinking. They believe that the god Zurvan was the original being and from Zurvan was born twins, Ahura Mazda and Angra Mainyu. This ‘Zurvanism’ puts Angra Mainyu on equal footing with Ahura Mazda, and even calls them brothers. With the crown tied to the divinity of Ahura Mazda, reducing his role could damage your legitimacy. These ideas are quickly spreading though. Should this line of thought be encouraged to take hold?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Thoughts, Words and Deeds

options.text: Thoughts well thought.
Words well spoken.
Deeds well done.
I will try to better myself for his cause.

events.text: The [religion] god Ahura Mazda is locked in a constant battle against the evil spirit Angra Mainyu to rid the world of the imperfections of its creation. It is only through the constant support of his followers that he gains the strength to fight. [character] corners you one day after the morning yasna sacrifice. “Rituals may aid Ahura Mazda, but it is through well-purposed thoughts, words and deeds that we give the most help.”

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Treachery

options.text: Quell this rebellion with overwhelming force.
Aid the innocents caught in the conflict.
Offer to hear [character]'s demands.

requirements.label: Commander / Inspiring
tip: The leader must have one of: Commander; Inspiring

options.text: Order the treasonous troops to stand down.

events.text: We have received a troubling message from the training grounds in [city]. After sowing seeds of treason among the ranks, General [character] and his most loyal soldiers have turned traitorous. He and his troops have seized a local armory and are taking to the streets. What is the court's command?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Truth and Order

options.text: Denounce [character]. Asha, truth and order, is sacred above all.
I know it is right, but I cannot.

events.text: [character] has made a serious accusation, that [character] of the [family] family lied to get his friend out of trouble. Such deceit is unthinkable to any [religion], and is an insult to both Ahura Mazda and Mithra. [character] may well be a servant of The Lie, the Angra Mainyu’s greatest follower. Your own honesty makes it difficult to let this go.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Turning of the Wheels

options.text: [character] will watch as he loses everything that he loves.
Leave me to grieve my son.

events.text: You are walking down the steps of the palace with your family when [character] breaks from the crowd, knife in hand. "This is for [character]!" he cries, raising the blade. The royal guards move to protect you, but too late they realize that you are not the target. With horror you are forced to watch as the knife falls on [character], who tries to block the attack in vain. The guards jump at [character], capturing him and forcing him to his knees. The assassin looks up in defiance and hatred, "Now you too know the pain of losing your family."

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: War in the Stars

options.text: Offer extra sacrifices to Tishtrya.
Increase the stockpiles in case of drought.

events.text: The god Tishtrya shines as a star in the night sky as he battles the demon Apaosha, also known as drought. The two duel in the form of horses as the star rises. The Magi of [religion] are warning that they have never seen the star shine this brightly before, and believe that it may signify that there are difficult times ahead.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: World of Thought

options.text: What an interesting idea!
Denounce his work, Ahura Mazda is lord of all.
Well, each to their own.

events.text: The Scholar Archetype [character] has published a series of texts on Dualism, documenting his personal experience with the rituals of [religion]. He argues that the existence of sin despite the rituals shows that the physical world was actually created by Angra Mainyu while Ahura Mazda dwells in a pure world of thought. Was Ahura Mazda really not the creator of the world?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: [religion] Mob

options.text: Send the military to forcefully disperse them.
Arrest the instigator [character].
Come to an understanding with their leaders.
Leave them be.

events.text: A mob of furious [religion] have gathered in the streets around the palace, riled by the fiery speeches of [character] and your recent actions against the faith. Your advisors warn that the mob are on the verge of breaking into violence. How do you intervene?

events.author: Solver
events.name: [religion] Pilgrims

options.text: If they come in peace, they are welcome to pray. [religion] is welcoming to the faithful.
Take the pilgrims hostage. We can use them as leverage in the war.

events.text: Our scouts report that, despite the ongoing war, a band of [rival] pilgrims is headed for the holy city of [city] where they wish to pray and receive blessings as devout [religion].
